units.title: Fix dead cosKr lead-angle term in TurningForceEngine.Fp + route GA fitness through it
units.diagnosis: 2026-07-05 (whiskey): the cron's hinted formula Fp=Fc*kp*cos(kr)/cos(kr_ref=95) is PHYSICALLY WRONG — cos(95deg)=-0.087, so the normalization blows up + flips sign (at kr=45deg it gives Fp=-8.1*Fc*kp). Worse, the empirical FORCE_RATIOS (TurningForceEngine.ts:76-83) don't decompose geometrically: kf/kp=1.6 != tan(95deg), so they're lumped values a simple sin/cos rotation can't retrofit without a large regression at the reference point. A correct fix needs a documented calibration reference for FORCE_RATIOS OR a mechanistic edge-coefficient (Ktc/Krc/Kfc) model calibrated against measured turning-force data + physics-review. Do NOT ship the naive cosKr scaling.
units.target: mcp-server/src/engines/TurningForceEngine.ts:76-146 (FORCE_RATIOS/Fp: cosKr computed L113 but Fp=Fc*ratios.kp L144-146 has NO angle term); mcp-server/src/engines/LatheGeneticAlgorithmEngine.ts:1852-1944 (fitness reimplements bare Fc=kc1_1*ap*f^(1-mc), blind to radial force)
units.buildHint: BOTH lens agents ranked this #1 accuracy. (1) Apply cos(kr)/cos(kr_ref=95) scaling to Fp so passive/radial force responds to insert lead angle. (2) Route LatheGeneticAlgorithmEngine fitness through TurningForceEngine.calculate() instead of its inline degenerate Kienzle (dedup: don't reimplement a 3rd time). BLAST-RADIUS: Fp feeds BoringBarDeflection + PartDeflection + chatter — re-run every Fp/deflection reference test THROUGH the dispatcher (R15). safety-physics arm required.

units.title: Upgrade GA constraint handling to Deb feasibility-first domination + populate avg_constraint_violation
units.target: mcp-server/src/engines/LatheGeneticAlgorithmEngine.ts (compareFitness ~L2349 already implements Deb lexicographic constraint-domination on individual.constraint_violation; evolve() ~L1605 evaluates fitnessFunction directly and never populates constraint_violation, so the branch is inert + statistics.avg_constraint_violation is always 0)
units.buildHint: FOLLOW-UP to U-LW-GA-CONSTRAINTS (arm A P2 + arm B P2). The soft exterior penalty shipped there can sit ~5% over the boundary and returns the least-infeasible point when the feasible region is empty. compareFitness ALREADY implements Deb's constraint-domination (any feasible beats any infeasible) — but it's inert because evolve never sets individual.constraint_violation. Route evolve's evaluation through evaluateFitness (or set constraint_violation on each individual) so: (1) whenever ANY feasible point exists in the population the returned best is GUARANTEED feasible (no 5%-over), and (2) statistics.avg_constraint_violation reports the real value instead of a hardcoded 0. Requires threading constraints into evolve() -- blast-radius its 3 callers (optimizeParameters, optimizeToolSequence, optimizeMultiPassStrategy); make the constraints arg optional/default [] so the other two are unchanged. safety-physics arm required (it hardens a machine-limit guard). Test: with a non-empty feasible region the recommendation is STRICTLY <= max_power (no tolerance), and avg_constraint_violation > 0 when infeasible candidates were sampled.
